pc_changelog:
v5.5.0 — Critical Connectivity Fix

• Fixed: PeerManager dead reconnection loop after restart
• Local URL caching for instant peer reconnection
• URLs preserved in Firebase for reliability
• Parallel chunked upload for CF files >256KB
• Shared HttpClient with connection pooling
• Verbose handshake diagnostics
